lines.text: Joshua and all the Israelites leave Shittim early in the morning and camp at the Jordan before crossing.
The officers tell the people to follow the ark carried by the Levitical priests, keeping about two thousand cubits back.
The LORD says He will begin to exalt Joshua so Israel knows He is with him, as with Aaron.
When the priests' feet touch the water, the Jordan stands still and backs up as far as Adam, near Bethel.
The priests stand firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan until the entire nation crosses.
